label: baseline-87bf217

conditions.workload: Fixed ceil(seconds/feed_period) rounds; delayed rounds are retained and actual duration reported

measurement.clock: One Python observer time.monotonic(); all event times are seconds since run start
measurement.e2e: Actual source capability acceptance -> actual target capability extraction; each event lies within its RCON request/reply interval. Bounds are not world-save times.
measurement.polling: Low-flow completion includes target polling cadence; output is not observed until an actual pull succeeds.
measurement.db_transactions: Sum of cumulative ct_test status db_transactions differences on A/B/C; includes controls, heartbeat/permission refresh and ambient loaded devices, excludes observer root SQL.
measurement.sql_statement_events: performance_schema account summary WHERE USER='ct_dev', statement/sql/* events only; counts attempts including retries, not JDBC round trips. Account-wide, including any running perf JVM.
measurement.wal: Not measured on unmodified baseline: no WAL timing/count instrumentation exists.
measurement.conservation: Accepted FE = actual extracted FE after drain; local buffers and SQL residue checked empty independently. SQL transfer remaining and local/WAL copies are never added together.
measurement.steady_e2e: Aggregate throughput/fairness only: overlapped FE inputs have no packet identity; no invented per-input steady latency.
measurement.fixture: Fresh console-owned blocks, vanilla chunk load tickets; no online-player, GUI, machine-container or injected network-latency claim.

failures: ValueError: RCON process does not use the isolated dev fixture config for A
